evidence.reason: The Production Activity is modeled as rules + Hetman + reign. The Encyclopedia of Ukraine identifies Ivan Mazepa as Hetman of Ukraine in 1687-1709 and its Hetman office chronology also lists Mazepa 1687-1709. His 1708 break with Peter I and Russian removal did not end all recognition of his hetmancy; for an office/reign Activity, 1709 is the historically standard endpoint. Preserve the existing start year and change only the end year from 1708 to 1709.
evidence.source: Encyclopedia of Ukraine, Ivan Mazepa; Hetman
